review.notes:
All 10 physical pages' extracted text was block-compared against the OCR markdown after normalization; the prose sections are fully present and the physical p.10 Frontier Safety table was cell-by-cell verified against the page text layer and render. The physical p.5 benchmark table has no PDF text layer (printed as an image), so its 146 cells were checked against a 130 dpi render: all values match, but OCR glued the stacked two-line cells, repaired here with
following the established gemini-3-7-flash-model-card precedent. Physical p.6 was rendered to confirm 'Intended Usage and Limitations' is a section heading at the same level as its siblings. Kept without patches: the leading '## Gemini 3 Pro Model Card' duplicate of the reader title and the pipeline-style '# Gemini 3 Pro - Model Card' line (same pattern as the Gemini 3 Pro Image card); 'Machine Learning R&D' and 'CCL not reached' cell line wraps are plain wrapping; the tiny OmniDocBench 1.5 description sub-label read as 'OCR' is consistent with the benchmark name and was not re-patched.
